name: player_keeptradecut_value year split with an as_of_month_day anchor
description: Baseline emission for the as_of_month_day param under a year row axis. Pins that the boundary is the doubly-clamped make_date expression anchored on opening_days.year rather than date_trunc('day', opening_days.opening_day), and that everything around it is untouched: the opening_days join stays, both opening_days.year predicates stay, the 30-day recency floor is still derived from the clamped boundary, and the single as_of_observed_at lookup still serves the axis. Regenerating this fixture against an emitter that dropped the param would produce the opening-day boundary instead.
expected_query: with "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2023,2024,2025]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years), "t568be828d136ab4becd57df879ae0fba" as (with recursive ktc_pid_scan as ((select pid from keeptradecut_valuations order by pid limit 1) union all select (select ktc_next.pid from keeptradecut_valuations ktc_next where ktc_next.pid > ktc_pid_scan.pid order by ktc_next.pid limit 1) from ktc_pid_scan where ktc_pid_scan.pid is not null) select pid from ktc_pid_scan where pid is not null), "t4100c36803b3f8032d4f4be1d95746b7" as (select ktc_p.pid, ktc_od.year, ktc_latest.keeptradecut_value from t568be828d136ab4becd57df879ae0fba ktc_p cross join (select ktc_od_src.year, ktc_od_src.opening_day from opening_days ktc_od_src inner join base_years on base_years.year = ktc_od_src.year) ktc_od cross join lateral (select ktc_src.keeptradecut_value from keeptradecut_valuations ktc_src where ktc_src.pid = ktc_p.pid and ktc_src.is_superflex = true and ktc_src.keeptradecut_value is not null and ktc_src.observed_at <= LEAST(make_date((ktc_od.year) + 0, 3, 1) + (1 - 1) * interval '1 day', make_date((ktc_od.year) + 0, 3, 1) + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')::timestamptz and ktc_src.observed_at > (LEAST(make_date((ktc_od.year) + 0, 3, 1) + (1 - 1) * interval '1 day', make_date((ktc_od.year) + 0, 3, 1) + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')::timestamptz - interval '30 days') order by ktc_src.observed_at desc limit 1) ktc_latest) select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "t2802b3532d50293f7240efc7336cbdb7"."keeptradecut_value" AS "player_keeptradecut_value_0", "player_years"."year", "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years" on "player_years"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "t4100c36803b3f8032d4f4be1d95746b7" as "t2802b3532d50293f7240efc7336cbdb7" on "t2802b3532d50293f7240efc7336cbdb7"."pid" = "player"."pid" and t2802b3532d50293f7240efc7336cbdb7.year = (player_years.year) group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "t2802b3532d50293f7240efc7336cbdb7"."keeptradecut_value", "player_years"."year", "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 10
